title: Netanyahu denies report that Trump blocked planned Israeli strike on October 10
summary_full: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel has refuted allegations that President Donald Trump interrupted a military mission planned against Iran. A Financial Times article suggested that Israel had intentions for airstrikes on Iran’s nuclear facilities, which were ultimately dropped due to Trump's disapproval, influenced by worries regarding economic fallout before the midterm elections, particularly concerning fuel prices.
